bindings.json.preprocessing: Identical unaugmented padded 64^3 cases; model.eval(); CUDA AMP; no training or checkpoint reselection.

generalization.json.interpretation: Lower error/rate is better; higher Dice is better. Gaps use case means, never pooled split totals. Training-only improvement is descriptive, not proof of overfitting. Validation selected checkpoints and has been used for development; bootstrap excludes selection and seed uncertainty.

edge_vs_dice.delta_direction: candidate minus reference; lower error/distance is better; higher Dice is better
